info.title: RIP_Interface
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address-family.description:
Reference Resource: [RIP_Interface](#/RIP_Interface)
RIP interfaces associated with this router instance. `ipv4`: List of IPv4 RIP_Interfaces with intf_key as prefix address in A.B.C.D format. `ipv6`: List of IPv6 RIP_Interfaces with intf_key as interface name.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Port corresponding to this RIP interface. If not set, RIP is not operational on that port.

receive.description: `receive`: RIP updates will be received on this interface.  `doNotReceive`: RIP updates will not be received on this interface.

send.description: `send`: RIP updates will be sent out this interface.  `doNotSend`: RIP updates will not be sent out this interface.

received_bad_packets.description: The number of RIP response packets received on this  interface which were subsequently discarded for  reasons such as invalid version, unknown command type,  local resource failure and authentication failure.

received_bad_routes.description: Number of invalid RIP packets received on this interface  and ignored for reasons such as unknown address family,  invalid metric or a local resource failure. It does not include routes ignored for policy reasons.

sent_updates.description: Number of triggered RIP updates that were sent out  this interface. This does not include full updates  that were sent out with new information.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: RIP_Router.instance_tag
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [RIP_Router](#/RIP_Router)
The list of all the RIP IPv4 Router instances.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
